text:
lena (devex): Heads uprelease pipeline published @redwood/sdk-go v0.9.6 but post-publish typegen check failed on the tag.
ryan: wait we released already? what failed exactly?
lena (devex): action output: 
```
yarn workspace @redwood/sdk-go typegen:check
Error: Generated types out of date: pkg/client/openapi_types.go
- old: Bar *string
+ new: Bar string
Run: yarn typegen:regen
```
doca: I think the openapi change that made Bar required was merged in the changelog PR, but the release job creates the tag before running a final regen verification.
typegen-bot: Runner CLI: v2.1.0 detected. Note: v2.1.0 changed default "preserve-optional" behavior.
lena (devex): So we have two problems: runner tool version drift and release order. Tag created, package published, then check fails.
ryan: quick fix: push a regen commit to main and cut a v0.9.7 patch that references the original changelog. Longer fix: make release action run typegen:check BEFORE tagging and fail the job if diffs. Also pin the tool version in the action container.
doca: I prefer failing before tag. Auto-committing from the release action is scary for audit reasons. Better to surface the diff and abort so a human can review.
ci-bot: [CI] PR #1242 (regen): unit tests OK, typegen-check failing (expected until regen commit staged).
lena (devex): I'll open PR with the regen commit right now and a follow-up PR to change .github/workflows/release.yml. Proposed snippet: 
```
- name: Verify generated types
  run: |
    yarn workspace @redwood/sdk-go typegen:check || (echo "Typegen out of date. Run yarn typegen:regen and commit. Aborting release." && exit 1)
```
ryan: also add a small check that ensures generated files aren't modified without a commit prefix like "chore(gen): regen" to help trace changes.
doca: and add a line in the release playbook: "Always run typegen:regen and commit before generating changelog/tags". I'll update docs.
lena (devex): filing issue to pin tool + gating: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-ex/issues/456
release-bot: Release v0.9.6 exists.
ryan: remediation plan: merge regen PR, cut v0.9.7 patch with note "post-release regen of client types", notify marketplace team if needed.
lena (devex): merging regen PR after green CI, then will cut patch and open the release-workflow PR. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
--end of thread--
